central_question: Can a co-located classical decoder keep pace with measurement and feedback in a quantum error-correction workflow?
claims_and_limits: IBM Nighthawk r2 and ORNL Umbra, using AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs and fifth-generation EPYC CPUs, are co-located at IBM Poughkeepsie for research.
Low-latency quantum-classical execution is the design goal; the announcement does not provide independent new-platform latency or throughput benchmarks.
Starling by 2029 is IBM's plan, not a fault-tolerant result demonstrated by this platform.

visual.shared_motif: Cyan quantum research enclosure beside CPU/GPU racks, with measurement and conditional-feedback paths; imagery is not an exact representation of the installed hardware.
visual.status: Conceptual quantum-classical research illustration; no quantitative system claim.
